questions.question_text: The word 'decoding' in the process of communication refers to ________
questions.answer: Decoding is the process of interpreting and comprehending the sender's message.

questions.question_text: A type of communication that occurs between a human being and a non-human entity is ________
questions.answer: Extrapersonal communication involves interaction between human beings and non-human entities (like animals, machines, or nature).

questions.question_text: Attitude barriers can be minimized through ________ sessions.
questions.answer: Counselling sessions help address and minimize personal and attitude-related barriers to communication.

questions.question_text: Technical communication is effective only when you are addressing ________
questions.answer: Technical communication uses specialized terminology and concepts that require a technically aware audience to be fully effective.
questions.chapter: Unit 2 - English: The Language of Science & Technology

options: List of things to be checked or done
questions.answer: A checklist is fundamentally a list of items required, things to be done, or points to be considered.
questions.chapter: Unit 2 - English: The Language of Science & Technology

questions.question_text: ________ is a diagrammatic representation of a step by step process.
questions.answer: A flowchart visually maps out the sequence of steps and decisions in a process.
questions.chapter: Unit 2 - English: The Language of Science & Technology

questions.question_text: Which of the following in an example for synchronous communication?
questions.answer: Synchronous communication happens in real-time, such as during a live video chat.

questions.question_text: Submitting a work via Google Classroom that will be viewed and graded tomorrow is an example of ________.
questions.answer: Sending information that will be read and responded to at a later time is asynchronous communication.

questions.question_text: Netiquette is a shortened form of ________
questions.answer: Netiquette is a portmanteau of the words 'Internet' and 'etiquette'.

questions.question_text: Following Netiquettes will help you to ________
options: Get along better with your friends
questions.answer: Netiquette guidelines promote respectful interactions and help users avoid offensive or inappropriate behavior online.

questions.question_text: What should you focus on during the interview?
questions.answer: During an interview, focusing on the value and contributions you can bring to the company highlights your professional merit.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is NOT an opening line of a response letter?
options: I am writing to you in relation to...
We recently wrote to you about...
questions.answer: 'We recently wrote to you about...' is typically used for a follow-up or an initiating letter, rather than a direct response to a client's inquiry.

questions.question_text: The quality of the mangoes ________ not good.
questions.answer: The subject 'quality' is singular, so it takes the singular verb 'is'.

questions.question_text: Minutes of the meeting refers to ________
options: Record of the discussion of the meeting
Points to be discussed in the meeting
List of participants of the meeting
questions.answer: Meeting minutes are the official written record of the discussions held and decisions made during a meeting.
